### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via /:object/:id/change-owner (route, bridged from symbol changeRecordOwner — its route source's handler names it), /:object/change-owner (route, bridged from symbol changeRecordsOwner — its route source's handler names it))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_ERROR (literal, 39 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `795bf365de7be3d30d104dd76492ddb23bbc8a85` — the merge of head `c5f810a35edca48944a82980657c06bab19e144f` into base `bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 795bf365de7be3d30d104dd76492ddb23bbc8a85 && git checkout 795bf365de7be3d30d104dd76492ddb23bbc8a85
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd c5f810a35edca48944a82980657c06bab19e144f && git checkout -B drift-repro bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd && git merge --no-ff c5f810a35edca48944a82980657c06bab19e144f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs bfc0dd054ba4e05ba35cc3f77d8260c0e144f2bd` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Read against GitHub and origin/main, not against the dev report's own words.

|:--|:--|
| CI (`l1-face --pr 38023`) | 57 success · 11 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; floor checks green |

| Declarations | `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm, so no dogfood is owed |

Premise, re-read on main: the by-id update throws `recordNotFoundError` before the write when the row is missing (`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`, the not-found gate at about line 932, by-id branch only). Its comment at about line 891 names a `null` read-back after a landed owner hand-away. So treating the read-back as moved is correct, and a missing row still answers 404 from the engine.

#36262: `carriesQueueColumn` in core is now `resolveInjectedColumnProvenance(def, 'queue') === 'injected-provisioned'`, the spec-level form of the engine's test. Core cannot import objectql, which depends on core.

Flags from l1-face, both accepted:
- `Fixes #36262` is the folded family the claim named (comment 7222680459). Merging is meant to close both cards.
- No changeset for `@objectstack/rest`: the only rest file is `src/change-owner-routes.test.ts`. `packages/rest/package.json` `files` = `dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md`, and `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so nothing published changes. The `@objectstack/core` changeset is present.

Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: both bullets match the code. The sentence "A field the author declared and named `queue` is not the ownership queue" is the behaviour of `injected-provisioned`, and the dev recorded it in Acceptance notes.

In-place adjacent fix: the same null → 404 check in `runCascade`'s child write. It is the same defect class, mechanical, unclaimed and in the same gate family, and the PR body names it with its pin. Accepted.

Ablations reported: restoring each removed branch turns its pins red (single path 3, bulk 2, queue test 4).

Out of scope: the remote driver's answer to a queue write was not traced. Dropped: after this fix the write no longer reaches it.

State: ACCEPT → ready + auto-merge.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [46041141973](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46041141973) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Build Core](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46041141973/job/140649128734)** — 失败步骤: Build packages (excluding docs)（日志不可读，点进 job 看）
- **[Live E2E UI](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46041141973/job/140649129077)** — 失败步骤: Build the Console for the live lane

  ```
  ✗ Build failed in 5.95s
  ```
- **[Build & E2E UI](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46041141973/job/140651284457)** — 失败步骤: Build the Console for E2E

  ```
  ✗ Build failed in 4.33s
  ```
- **[Type Check UI](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46041141973/job/140651284490)** — 失败步骤: Verify every sideEffects array names exactly its registering modules（日志不可读，点进 job 看）

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- ⚠️ **本次没有可用的聚合签名**（日志里没有能解析出测试文件名的 FAIL 行）—— 这不是「没有同签名的其他 PR」，是**这一轮没测到**。跨 PR 聚合本次不可用，请手工比对其他 PR 的同类评论。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 15 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
